clue.text: Spongy ball gone missing outside

indicators.note: outside tells us the word for gone missing wraps round the word for ball

parts.note: something that has gone missing is absent
an orb is a ball or sphere

explanation.surface: A ball has disappeared and turns up somewhere outdoors, soft and squishy.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a spongy material soaks up liquid readily, which is what an absorbent one does.

clue.text: Being outspoken, a liberal couple moved north

indicators.note: in a down clue, moving north means the word for couple is read upwards

parts.note: a duo is a couple or pair

explanation.surface: A Liberal pair relocates up north and makes a fuss about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moved north' turns DUO into OUD, since the clue runs down the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking out loud, audibly rather than silently, is a loose sense of being outspoken.

clue.text: It says salad covered in soil is inevitably a mess!

definitions.text: It says salad covered in soil is inevitably a mess!

indicators.note: in a down clue, the salad lying covered by soil puts the soil word on top, first

parts.note: sod is turf, the top layer of soil
slaw (coleslaw) is a cabbage salad

explanation.surface: A grim little law: drop your salad in the dirt and it is ruined.
explanation.walkthrough: SOD'S LAW is the British saying that if something can go wrong, it will.
explanation.definitionFit: The principle that whatever can go wrong will, such as salad landing in the soil, is the rule known by this name.

clue.text: Furrows poorly fitted into hollowed out ridges

indicators.note: fitted into says the word for poorly goes inside the remaining letters
hollowed out means the inside of ridges is removed, leaving only its end letters

parts.note: poorly means ill, unwell

explanation.surface: Badly made grooves set into scooped-out ridges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hollowed out' means 'ridges' keeps only its first and last letters; 'fitted into' sets the poorly word between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Rills are small channels or grooves in the ground, akin to furrows cut by running water.

clue.text: Honour vet sadly leaving benevolent organisation?

indicators.note: sadly signals that the remaining letters are in a sorry, jumbled state
organisation means the letters of benevolent are reorganised once the other word leaves

explanation.surface: A vet unhappily quits a charity, honoured for their service.
explanation.walkthrough: Take V, E, T out of BENEVOLENT ('leaving') and rearrange what is left, BNEOLEN, to get the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To ennoble someone is to raise them to the nobility, a great honour, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Time Elvis interrupted singer getting earful

indicators.note: interrupted means the Elvis word breaks into the middle of the singer word

parts.note: an alto is a singer with a low female or high male voice
Elvis Presley was known as the King

explanation.surface: A singer's moment is cut short by Elvis barging in, and someone gets an earful.
explanation.walkthrough: Elvis Presley's nickname was 'the King'. 'interrupted' means that word breaks into the singer word after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a talking-to is a scolding, the same as getting an earful from someone.

clue.text: Girlfriend saved by AA? It appears on camera

indicators.note: saved by means the girlfriend letters are held safe within the AA letters

parts.note: taken as written, the letters A A

explanation.surface: A girlfriend rescued by the motoring organisation shows up in a photo.
explanation.walkthrough: The AA is Britain's Automobile Association, the breakdown service, so 'saved by AA' fits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Agfa is a brand of photographic film and cameras, so its name appears on a camera body.

clue.text: A small games producer has single weapon

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
Sega is a Japanese video-game company
I, the Roman numeral one, means single

explanation.surface: A minor video-game company now owns a lone weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: An assegai is a slender spear used in southern Africa, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Look into financier's blunders

indicators.note: into means the word for look goes inside the word for financiers

parts.note: funders are financiers; the possessive is read as a plural
lo is an old exclamation meaning look

explanation.surface: Investigate the mistakes made by a money man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Look' is the old exclamation 'lo!' here, not an instruction; 'into' puts it after the first letter of the financiers word.
explanation.definitionFit: To flounder is to stumble or blunder helplessly, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Whiny singer with boy band playing around Leatherhead

indicators.note: around means the shuffled letters surround the single head letter
playing suggests the letters move about and rearrange

parts.note: the head of the word Leather is L; Leatherhead is also a Surrey town

explanation.surface: A boy band performs in the Surrey town of Leatherhead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' rearranges BOYBAND to BOBDYAN; 'around' puts L, the head of 'Leather', inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Bob Dylan is a singer famous, and often mocked, for his nasal, whining voice.

clue.text: Left side only half cut, causing damage

indicators.note: half cut means each of the three words loses its second half, keeping just its front two letters

explanation.surface: A left-sided slice that only went halfway still did harm.
explanation.walkthrough: The front halves of the four-letter words give LE, SI and ON.
explanation.definitionFit: A lesion is damage to tissue, such as a wound or ulcer, so it is a kind of injury.

clue.text: Nothing odd in hand-built test for grown-ups

indicators.note: nothing odd means the odd-numbered letters go, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: No irregularities found in a craftsman-made trial for adults.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of HANDBUILTTEST are A, D, U, L, T, S.
explanation.definitionFit: Adults are grown-ups, fully developed people, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Going from bank to bank to get short-term finance

definitions.meaning: spanning a river, from one bank to the other
a temporary loan that covers a gap, such as between buying and selling a house

explanation.surface: Moving money between banks to raise a quick loan.
explanation.definitionFit: A bridge spans from bank to bank, and a bridging loan is short-term finance.

clue.text: Appear to embarrass turn out

definitions.meaning: to make someone look bad by comparison

explanation.surface: Turning up just to humiliate someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb has all three senses: arrive, outshine someone, and attend.

clue.text: Pageboy perhaps a slithery rogue

indicators.note: rogue means out of control, so the letters break ranks and reorder

explanation.surface: A page boy, maybe, is a sly and slippery villain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pageboy' looks like a young attendant, but it is a bob haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: A pageboy is a short, rounded haircut, given here as one example of a hairstyle.

clue.text: Chances of university abandoning details of courses

indicators.note: abandoning means the university letter is dropped from the brochure word

parts.note: a prospectus gives details of courses offered by a college

explanation.surface: Odds on whether the university will scrap its course information.
explanation.definitionFit: Prospects are chances of future success, as in job prospects.

clue.text: Get grime off kitchen appliance

indicators.note: off means the letters are gone off, spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: Clean the dirt from a kitchen gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg timer is a small device used in the kitchen to time boiling eggs.

clue.text: Infestation has grown wild inside perimeter

indicators.note: inside means the shuffled letters go within the perimeter word

parts.note: a rim is an edge or perimeter

indicators.note: wild means the letters run riot and reorder

explanation.surface: Pests have run riot inside the boundary fence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is only a link. 'wild' rearranges 'grown', and 'inside' puts the result before the last letter of the perimeter word.
explanation.definitionFit: Ringworm is a fungal skin infection, loosely described here as an infestation.

clue.text: Devoted fan that is following band

indicators.note: following means the that-is letters come after the band word

parts.note: a band is a musical group
ie abbreviates id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A loyal follower, that is to say one who follows a band.
explanation.definitionFit: A groupie is an ardent fan who follows a band around.

clue.text: What God apparently did for senior mafioso?

definitions.meaning: Genesis says God created the first man
a fully initiated member of the Mafia

explanation.surface: Divine creation and a mob boss.
explanation.definitionFit: A made man is a fully inducted Mafia member; read literally, God created humankind.

clue.text: The point of sex overwhelms a groom, holding it back

annotationWithheld.why: 'The point of sex overwhelms a groom, holding it back' (6) for ORGASM: the def is 'The point of sex', but no parse found makes ORGASM from 'overwhelms a groom, holding it back' (A GROOM is one O off), and no blog yet.
annotationWithheld.clue: The point of sex overwhelms a groom, holding it back

clue.text: Girl, more delicate, is slow mover

parts.note: G is a dictionary abbreviation for girl
lacier means more lacy, finer and more delicate

explanation.surface: A girl, more refined than most, takes her time.
explanation.definitionFit: A glacier is a river of ice that moves extremely slowly.

clue.text: Legally blocked central thesis getting killed off

indicators.note: central means the middle letters of thesis are taken

parts.note: topped is slang for killed

explanation.surface: A dissertation's main argument shot down and ruled out in court.
explanation.walkthrough: The central two letters of 'thesis' are ES.
explanation.definitionFit: Legal term: a party estopped is barred from asserting something that contradicts what it said before.

clue.text: On introduction, bride's relatives are shocked seeing you flash

indicators.note: on introduction means the opening letter of each word is taken

explanation.surface: When she introduces them, the bride's family are scandalised to see you expose yourself.
explanation.definitionFit: Flash, as an adjective, means showy, the same as brassy.

clue.text: Half of boat keel he missed in photographic blur

indicators.note: half of means only the front half of each word is used, the rest missed out

explanation.surface: A missing half-hull on a boat has him looking blurry in pictures.
explanation.walkthrough: Halves of BOAT, KEEL and HE give BO, KE and H.
explanation.definitionFit: Bokeh is the soft, out-of-focus blur in parts of a photograph.

clue.text: Restrict growth of dangerous activity

definitions.meaning: a risky feat, as done by ... performers

explanation.surface: Stopping a plant growing, and a daredevil feat.
explanation.definitionFit: To stunt is to restrict growth; a stunt is a dangerous feat.

clue.text: Narrow minded compiler's theme lacks tension

parts.note: the compiler is the setter, so compiler's means my

indicators.note: lacks means the tension letter is missing from the theme word

parts.note: a topic is a theme or subject
T is the symbol for tension in physics

explanation.surface: The setter's subject is small-minded and dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Myopic literally means short-sighted, and figuratively narrow-minded.

clue.text: Reconcile lie

definitions.meaning: to become friends again after a quarrel

explanation.surface: Make up after a fib.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to settle a quarrel and to invent something false.

clue.text: Lake seen in home recording

indicators.note: seen in means the answer is visible within the run of letters

explanation.surface: A lake appears in a home video.
explanation.definitionFit: Mere is a poetic or regional word for a lake.

clue.text: Smooth World Cup hero got military training there

parts.note: to sand is to smooth a surface
Geoff Hurst scored a hat-trick for England in the 1966 World Cup final

explanation.surface: A slick footballing hero went to army college.
explanation.walkthrough: SANDHURST is Britain's Royal Military Academy, where army officers train.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandhurst is where British army officers get trained, so it is the place meant by 'there'.
